steps.what: Open the incoming mail for this office
Sort the incoming pieces by hand

tasks.design: Incoming mail for the office is listed in {OPS_SYSTEM} when it was logged. The courier opens, sorts, and distributes it by hand. The list does not carry the pieces.
tasks.previous_blocker: The courier sorted from the envelopes alone.
tasks.enabler_now: Logged pieces already have an office.
tasks.still_hard: Opening, sorting, and carrying the mail stay with the courier.
tasks.altitude: The mail handling does not change. A logged piece only names the office.

evidence.claim: A logged piece can name an office. Opening, sorting, and distributing stay with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when mail arrives and ends when it has been distributed or set aside.
A mail row has piece id and office, written when the piece was logged. An unlogged piece is sorted by the courier without a row.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often mail arrives with no log row.
research_questions: Which pieces were on the list, and which the courier sorted without one?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: most pieces are not logged. High: the office is on the list and the courier still opens, sorts, and distributes. The range stays under the net.

tasks.short: Confirm the run with the office

steps.what: Check with offices after the run and confirm the deliveries

tasks.design: Completed deliveries and collections are listed from {OPS_SYSTEM}, from stops the courier already closed. The courier checks with the home office after the run, confirms them, and receives instructions for other deliveries. The list does not make the call, and it does not mark a stop complete.
tasks.previous_blocker: The courier read a paper tally back over the telephone.
tasks.still_hard: The call, the confirmation, and hearing the next instruction stay with the courier.
tasks.human_edge: The courier knows what actually happened.

ambition.what: The closed stops are listed when the courier calls, and the courier still confirms them.

tasks.altitude: The courier speaks the confirmation. A stop the courier did not close is not on the list.

evidence.claim: Stops the courier already closed can be listed. Confirming them on a call stays with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a run's deliveries are done and ends when the courier has confirmed them and noted any new instruction.
A closed stop has stop id and the outcome the courier entered. The list is those rows. It does not add a completion.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the office disputes a completion.
research_questions: Which runs were confirmed as listed, and which the courier corrected on the call?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many stops were never closed, so the list is short. High: the closed stops are listed and the courier still calls and confirms. The range stays under the net.

steps.what: Open the verbal messages to deliver
Use the telephone to deliver verbal messages

tasks.design: A verbal message that was already written is opened from {DOCS}. The courier uses the telephone to deliver it. The screen does not place the call or speak the message. A message with no text is not invented.
tasks.previous_blocker: The courier memorised the message or read a scrap.
tasks.still_hard: Placing the call and speaking the message stay with the courier.
tasks.human_edge: The courier hears whether the person understood.
tasks.altitude: The call does not change. The text is only written down before the call.

evidence.claim: A message that was already written can be opened. Speaking it on the telephone stays with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a verbal message is to be delivered and ends when the courier has spoken it or noted that the person was not reached.
A message row has message id and text, written by the sender. Empty text is not filled.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often there is no written text.
research_questions: Which messages had text, and which the courier could not deliver?

steps.what: Perform general office clerical filing of materials
Keep operating duplicating machines or running errands

tasks.design: Materials waiting for filing are listed in {DOCS}. The courier performs the general office clerical filing, and keeps operating duplicating machines or running errands. The list does not file a paper or run an errand.
tasks.previous_blocker: The filing pile had no list.
tasks.enabler_now: Named materials are on the filing list.
tasks.still_hard: Filing papers, operating the machine, and running the errand stay with the courier.
tasks.human_edge: The courier handles the paper and the errand.
tasks.altitude: The clerical and errand work stays. The list only names what is waiting.

reach.task: Ask for an errand or a copy

evidence.claim: A list of materials waiting to be filed can be shown. Filing, copying, and errands stay with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when office work is waiting and ends when the courier has filed, copied, or run the errand.
A filing row has material id and place, entered by the office. The courier files that material. An unnamed paper is not given an id.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the work is an errand rather than a named file.
research_questions: Which materials were on the list, and which jobs were errands?

role.altitude: The courier still sorts mail, calls the office, speaks the message, and does the errands. A logged piece or a written message is open first.
reach: The office hears a confirmation only of stops the courier already closed.
skills_to_grow: Do not confirm a stop that was not closed.
Do not invent a verbal message.
role.ambitious_version: Closed stops and written messages are ready when the courier calls. The courier still sorts, confirms, speaks, and runs the errand.
